confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Malaysian price levels, not checked against live listings. Restaurant, beer, coffee and cocktail anchors are moderately confident; hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because Malacca accommodation varies widely by district and season. The FX observation came from search snippets that attribute 0.6947 USD per AUD to RBA mid-point rates for 2026-10-16. I did not read the rba.gov.au table directly, and one snippet put the 2026-10-16 figure from a third-party site, so verify it against the RBA F11 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against George Town (Penang) and other second-tier Malaysian heritage cities, adjusted down for Malacca's lower accommodation and dining prices and its smaller visitor base.
